baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired passive sayings at words 2 and 7 are joined to messengers at word 8 and temporal precedence at word 10.
baseline_models.mechanism: Uttered speech is borne as a message and encountered again along a succession of earlier messengers; the passive construction marks continuity without naming the present speaker.

activation_trace.role: Speech brought out in utterance supplies the repeated verbal material at both passive positions.
The messenger as carrier of a saying turns repetition into a relay rather than an isolated remark.
Temporal precedence places the current address downstream from earlier instances.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports an isolated statement addressed to the present messenger.
changed_reading.after: The present saying is one recurrence in an earlier messenger relay, so repetition itself establishes continuity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled saying at words 2 and 7 is left speakerless and linked to successive messengers.
baseline_models.mechanism: A saying can become talk circulating among people, while messengers arrive in successive groups; the focus can therefore mark a recurrent social refrain encountered by each messenger.

activation_trace.role: Publicly circulating talk supplies a refrain that can outlive any one speaker.
Successive groups supply the serial carriers or recipients across whom the refrain recurs.
Prior occurrence gives the circulating refrain historical depth.

changed_reading.before: The repeated content is only a stable proposition.
changed_reading.after: What repeats may also be a durable social reaction or refrain directed at successive messengers.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Lordship at word 12 governs the paired possessions of forgiveness at word 14 and painful punishment at words 16-17.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same sustaining Lord either protects a person from a fault's effect or administers its painful punitive aftermath; the pair names two governed responses rather than disconnected attributes.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion make lordship the administering frame for both outcomes.
Covering a fault and protecting its bearer from the effect supplies the restorative outcome.
An act's final aftereffect supplies the temporal result pole.
Punitive response after fault makes that result judicial as well as temporal.
Caused pain specifies the experienced force of the punitive aftermath.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness and punishment are merely opposite divine attributes appended to the statement.
changed_reading.after: They are two administered treatments of what follows human response: protective repair or painful consequence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated root at words 2 and 7 can name a thing's indication as well as voiced speech.
baseline_models.mechanism: The informative function of the saying can be foregrounded over identical wording: what recurs through messengers may be a disclosure that states or outcomes also indicate.

activation_trace.role: A thing's indication functioning as its saying opens a semiotic reading of the doubled passive.
The carried saying keeps that disclosure anchored to messenger transmission.

changed_reading.before: Only the same verbal propositions are repeated.
changed_reading.after: A recurrent disclosure or indication can be carried through messengers even when its concrete expression varies.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeats blocked hearing, a barrier, deliberate noise, and then a counterfactual change of language that still produces an objection. This makes the focus's recurrent saying a reception-invariant reaction script, not only identical transmitted content.

activation_trace.role: Circulating talk anchors the focus as a repeatable public reaction.
Weight in the ear supplies an internal reception block behind the spoken refusal.
Prevention of access turns the refusal into a barrier mechanism rather than a content rebuttal.
Mixed loud noise supplies an active tactic for preserving non-reception.
The counterfactual objection and commanded reply keep uttered speech active after the medium changes.
Lack of intelligible expression supplies the hypothetical changed medium.
The returning ear-weight shows that the reception block survives the language counterfactual.
Distance converts failed reception into a spatial image of a call that cannot be taken in.

structural_cues: The hearing barrier appears at 41:5, becomes deliberate noise at 41:26, and returns immediately after the focus at 41:44.
At 41:44 the language is counterfactually changed while objection and deafness remain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated ear-blocking and a changed-language counterfactual; I infer that stable reception posture causes the recurring saying. A live alternative is that the focus refers only to repeated prophetic content.

changed_reading.before: The same message is said again because prophetic content is constant.
changed_reading.after: The same kind of thing is said to the messenger because refusal reproduces itself even when the message's linguistic form is changed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence joins saying that God is Lord to upright persistence, then joins excellent saying to calling and action, and finally makes a better response transform hostility into protecting nearness. Repeated prophetic saying is therefore a performed stance with social effects.

activation_trace.role: Voiced saying supplies the focus anchor whose function is revised by the later action sequence.
Saying as held conviction makes the declaration a committed position.
Straightness and balance turn the declared conviction into sustained alignment.
Uttered speech frames both the excellent call and the speaker's self-location.
Intended action supplies the enacted counterpart that prevents saying from remaining verbal only.
Pushing away harm by the better response gives speech an active conflict-transforming function.
Protective friendship supplies the social state produced by that better response.

structural_cues: The sequence 41:30, 41:33, and 41:34 moves from declaration to uprightness, action, response, and changed relationship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated speech-to-action sequence and a transformed social relation; I infer that enactment is the directional link between saying and transformed hostility. The sayings can still retain distinct propositional content.

changed_reading.before: Prophetic continuity consists in receiving or repeating the same words.
changed_reading.after: Prophetic continuity also consists in inhabiting a repeated vocation: declare, remain upright, act, and answer harm in a way that can alter the relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: A saying becomes binding over earlier communities, recompense matches action, and a prior word controls when judgment is settled. The focus's repeated saying can thus include an operative verdict-pattern whose consequence recurs, not merely descriptive speech.

activation_trace.role: Ordinary utterance supplies the focus term whose force is expanded by contextual judgment scenes.
Punitive consequence supplies the result that an operative saying can govern.
A saying functioning as rule over another supplies the effective verdict.
Fixed obligation makes the saying bind rather than merely circulate.
Earlier communities supply the repeated historical field of the binding saying.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the verdict's realized consequence.
Intelligible speech connecting parties supplies the prior word that governs adjudication.
Precedence gives that word temporal priority over immediate settlement.
Decisive judgment supplies what the prior word delays or regulates.

structural_cues: At 41:25 saying, binding truth, prior communities, and loss occur in one construction.
At 41:45 a prior word explicitly stands between dispute and settled judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sayings that bind and a prior word that regulates judgment; I infer that operative force is one mode of what recurs in 41:43. A live alternative keeps these judgment uses separate from the focus's ordinary passive saying.

changed_reading.before: What was said before consists only of propositions or accusations.
changed_reading.after: What recurs can also be an effective word-pattern that becomes binding and governs when consequence arrives.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human covering is exposed as failed concealment, while hidden contents and emergent life remain fully known and encompassed. Against that sequence, forgiveness's covering is sharpened as protection granted with complete knowledge, not a hiding of the fault from the Lord.

activation_trace.role: A cover that also preserves supplies the focus image to be distinguished from concealment.
Human covering supplies the failed attempt to avoid bodily witness.
Knowledge as disclosure defeats the assumption that covering can hide action from God.
Hiddenness names precisely what the deviating acts fail to obtain.
A fruit's enclosing sheath supplies a real hidden container whose contents remain known.
Bringing a hidden thing outward supplies the transition from enclosure to disclosure.
Knowledge encompasses both the final hour and hidden organic emergence.
Complete encompassing in knowledge closes any route from covering to divine ignorance.

structural_cues: The surah moves from attempted self-concealment at 41:22 to non-hidden deviation at 41:40, enclosed fruit at 41:47, and total encompassing at 41:54.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protective covering, failed concealment, hidden enclosures, and complete knowledge; I infer that divine forgiveness covers an effect while leaving the fault fully known. Ordinary pardon remains a live, less image-dependent reading.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness means that the fault is simply covered over.
changed_reading.after: Forgiveness is a knowing protective cover: the fault is not hidden from the Lord, but its bearer can be shielded from its destructive effect.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recompense is matched to action, then good and evil are routed back to the acting self while lordly misplacement is denied. This strengthens the aftermath branch of punishment: painful consequence is administered as a just return of action rather than arbitrary injury.

activation_trace.role: The final effect of an act anchors punishment as aftermath.
Punitive response after fault keeps the aftermath judicial.
Matching action with recompense supplies proportional return.
Intended deeds supply the antecedent to which recompense answers.
The person's own intended act begins the explicit return-to-self construction.
The very self supplies the destination to which good action accrues.
The harmful deed supplies the negative action that returns upon its agent.
Putting a thing outside its due place supplies the misplacement explicitly denied of the Lord.

structural_cues: The matching formula at 41:27 is followed after the focus by the self-directed good/evil balance and denial of lordly injustice at 41:46.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matched recompense, self-return, and denied misplacement; I infer the causal arrow from deed to painful aftermath. A live alternative emphasizes an externally imposed judicial penalty without foregrounding self-return.

changed_reading.before: Painful punishment is an externally imposed threat standing opposite forgiveness.
changed_reading.after: Painful punishment is also the just administered aftereffect of what the agent has done, with no lordly misplacement.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus, harm's touch produces severed hope, mercy produces possessive speech and confidence in an unsecured outcome, and renewed harm produces expansive prayer. The stable lordly pair of forgiveness and punishment contains this unstable human swing between despair and entitlement.

activation_trace.role: Protection from a fault's effect supplies the hope-bearing pole of the stable pair.
Punitive accountability supplies the limiting pole of the stable pair.
The impact of evil supplies the immediate experiential trigger for the first swing.
Severed hope supplies the despairing extreme.
Merciful tenderness supplies the favorable change that triggers the opposite swing.
Saying as belief turns received mercy into the possessive position that it is inherently one's own.
An outcome that cannot be trusted supplies the unsecured future the speaker nevertheless claims.
A delivered report reverses self-assurance by announcing what deeds actually entail.
Painful penalty supplies the accountability denied by entitlement.
Favorable condition supplies the state in which the human turns away.
Calling by speech supplies the expansive plea that returns under harm.

structural_cues: The post-focus sequence 41:49-51 alternates harm, despair, mercy, entitlement, withdrawal, renewed harm, and prolonged calling.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the alternating response sequence; I infer that the focus's balanced pair is positioned to correct both one-sided reactions. The pair can alternatively remain a general statement with no specific psychological function.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness and punishment offer two abstract possibilities.
changed_reading.after: Their stable coexistence checks the human tendency to treat pain as hopeless finality and mercy as proof of unconditional entitlement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it extends saying from voiced propositions to created and embodied indication. It remains anchored in the focus's saying branch and in contextual scenes where creation and skins answer or testify; downstream prose should label it a cross-domain activation, not replace the direct verbal reading with it.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled saying at words 2 and 7 activates the branch in which a thing's indication functions as its saying.

activation_trace.role: A thing's indication as its saying supplies the semiotic focus anchor.
The sky-earth exchange gives created order an explicit responsive speech scene.
A speaking indication lets bodily surfaces disclose what their owners concealed.
Testimony as informed disclosure gives the bodily saying evidentiary force.
Witness by knowledge extends disclosure from bodies and signs to the encompassing witness.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns only verbal material repeated to messengers.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the recurrent saying also names a disclosure pattern in which created states and embodied effects answer and testify.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it aligns separate roots and a contextual front/behind geometry rather than claiming an etymological link. It remains anchored to the focus's explicit precedence and aftermath branches; downstream prose should present it as a spatial-temporal composition, not as a lexical derivation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Temporal precedence at word 10 and consequential aftermath at word 16 place the present address between an upstream relay and a downstream result.

activation_trace.role: What advances or precedes supplies the upstream side of the focus.
What follows as an act's outcome supplies the downstream side.
The interval between two sides supplies the corridor geometry immediately before the focus.
The position before the hands supplies the protected text's forward side.
The rearward side completes the bracketing front/behind image.
A word that precedes and regulates later judgment repeats the upstream-to-downstream sequence.

changed_reading.before: Earlier messengers are a historical comparison, and painful punishment is an unrelated closing warning.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the present address occupies a corridor between transmitted precedent and administered aftermath, echoing the protected text's front/behind bracketing.

strongest_changes: The repeated saying becomes a reception-invariant objection script: language can change while refusal persists.
Context turns saying into both enacted commitment and an effective verdict that governs consequence.
Forgiveness's cover is sharpened as known protection, while punishment reads as the just aftereffect of action.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence of saying across creation, opponents, bodies, believers, and judgment exposed several functional kinds of speech; the immediate front/behind and post-focus reception passages made the focus a hinge between prior relay and later consequence.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus leaves the speaker unspecified, so opponents' recurrent speech and revelation addressed through messengers remain live referents.
The known-protection and precedent/aftermath readings depend on branch and structural analogy and should not displace the direct forgiveness/punishment sense.
The effective-judgment branch is strongly context-activated, but not every occurrence of saying carries that force.
